stage: Governance P1-A3: Workflow-Templates und sichere Graph-Erzeugung (governance stage 6)
design: Eager atomic chain: applying a template creates the FULL linear step chain in ONE write_txn (cards + task_links edges + exactly one workflow_applied audit event); the existing parent promote gate IS the sequencing engine (no new routing/scheduler loop, proven sleep-free + diff-grep clean). Roles (not profiles) in template data; role_map resolves at apply time; profiles/forced skills/remote workspaces validated fail-closed BEFORE any insert (no partial graph). Root keeps the caller's idempotency_key (pre-txn + in-txn re-check closes the concurrent double-apply race), steps 2..N derive '{key}::wf:{template}:{step_key}'; retry reads the same chain back (deduplicated=True, no second event). review/approval_type are template metadata carried onto the step card body — the step card is the gate, human decisions keep flowing through the existing stage-2/review surfaces; a template never approves anything itself.
